name: isAPIAccountPermissionScoped
definition: True when JumpCloud's complete service-account inventory holds at least one service account and none of them has a full-admin role (Administrator With Billing or Administrator). False when any service account holds a full-admin role.
population: service accounts returned by GET /api/v2/service-accounts, read completely against totalCount
evidenceRequiredForTrue: a complete service-account list with at least one account and no account whose role is a full-admin system role

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the registry gate can fail push runs on main; proposed, single emitter. An empty inventory is not measured, by the file's own rule.
